description: JavaScript implementation of the SHA-1 cryptographic hash function, including functions for hashing strings, HMAC, and encoding conversions.

methods.name: hex_sha1
methods.description: Computes SHA-1 hash of a string and returns hex-encoded result.

methods.name: b64_sha1
methods.description: Computes SHA-1 hash of a string and returns base64-encoded result.

methods.name: any_sha1
methods.description: Computes SHA-1 hash of a string and encodes in arbitrary encoding.

methods.name: hex_hmac_sha1
methods.description: Computes HMAC-SHA1 with a key and data, returns hex-encoded result.

methods.name: b64_hmac_sha1
methods.description: Computes HMAC-SHA1 with a key and data, returns base64-encoded result.

methods.name: any_hmac_sha1
methods.description: Computes HMAC-SHA1 with a key and data, encodes in arbitrary encoding.

methods.name: sha1_vm_test
methods.description: Performs a self-test to verify SHA-1 implementation correctness.

methods.name: rstr_sha1
methods.description: Calculates SHA-1 hash of a raw string.

methods.name: rstr_hmac_sha1
methods.description: Calculates HMAC-SHA1 of a key and data (raw strings).

methods.name: rstr2hex
methods.description: Converts a raw string to a hex string.

methods.name: rstr2b64
methods.description: Converts a raw string to a base64 string.

methods.name: rstr2any
methods.description: Converts a raw string to an arbitrary encoding.

methods.name: str2rstr_utf8
methods.description: Encodes a string as UTF-8.

methods.name: str2rstr_utf16le
methods.description: Encodes a string as UTF-16 little-endian.

methods.name: str2rstr_utf16be
methods.description: Encodes a string as UTF-16 big-endian.

methods.name: rstr2binb
methods.description: Converts a raw string to an array of big-endian words.

methods.name: binb2rstr
methods.description: Converts an array of big-endian words to a string.

methods.name: binb_sha1
methods.description: Calculates SHA-1 of an array of big-endian words with length.

methods.name: sha1_ft
methods.description: Performs SHA-1 specific logical functions based on iteration.

methods.name: sha1_kt
methods.description: Returns the SHA-1 constant for a given iteration.

methods.name: safe_add
methods.description: Adds two 32-bit integers with wrap-around.

methods.name: bit_rol
methods.description: Performs a bitwise rotate left on a 32-bit number.
